title: Fishing in Madeira: Espada, Tuna and the Fishermen at Sea
description: See how Madeira fishermen work: deep water espada, tuna, the Câmara de Lobos boats, and what you can spot on a private boat trip from Funchal. Tips inside.
heroAlt: Traditional fishing boats at Câmara de Lobos in Madeira at golden hour
